title: How does voxel cone tracing work?
abstract:
Assume that we have voxelized a 3D scene into a regular 3D grid of cubes, storing the average (diffuse) radiance and some flag indicating whether or not a voxel is empty. Next, the finer levels of the 3D texture (voxels) are downsampled to get coarser levels ("pre-integrated") which will be stored as MIP levels for that texture. ( I know that some sparser structures can be used instead, but a regular grid is conceptually the most easiest to master first. ) 
 Now, given that we have our surface position (and thus also the voxel we are in), how does voxel cone tracing work and how is it applied?
